{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Okeanos Gas Gathering System''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/About-Us/Natural-Gas-Transmission-Midstream-and-LNG/Offshore-Pipelines|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Na Kika development area, Gulf of Mexico to Destin Main Pass 260 platform, Gulf of Mexico.

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Enbridge Inc<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/About-Us/Natural-Gas-Transmission-Midstream-and-LNG/Offshore-Pipelines|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''100 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.offshore-mag.com/home/article/16774289/bp-and-shell-to-build-deepest-gas-gathering-system-in-gulf-of-mexico|title=offshore-mag.com|website=offshore-mag.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.offshore-mag.com/home/article/16774289/bp-and-shell-to-build-deepest-gas-gathering-system-in-gulf-of-mexico|title=offshore-mag.com|website=offshore-mag.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/About-Us/Natural-Gas-Transmission-Midstream-and-LNG/Offshore-Pipelines|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
